title: etbb-july-2024-february-2026-update.pdf — section 102
text:
69. It is open to a party to ask that a previously granted special measure be lifted or to opt out
of special measures altogether if there has been a material change in circumstances. Care
should be taken to ensure this is a genuine request and not for some underlying reason,
such as frustration or threats. The request should be carefully assessed by the court before
granting it to ensure it is in the interests of justice to alter the special measures direction.
Participation directions in the Family Court

70. A family court must consider whether the quality of evidence given by a party or witness
is likely to be diminished by reason of vulnerability and, if so, whether it is necessary to
make one or more participation directions. Victims of domestic abuse are now automatically
deemed vulnerable.
